_comment: Cinematic background beds + stings. Generated to public/assets/audio/music/<id>.mp3 by tools/generate-sfx.mjs (ElevenLabs sound effects). Played under the procedural suit/wind sound and ducked under dialogue.

beds.prompt: Cinematic ambient drone for a vast lonely Mars desert: deep sub-bass hum, slow evolving warm analog synth pad, faint thin distant wind, sparse and spacious, no percussion, no melody, seamless loop
Mysterious underground ice cave ambience: low resonant drone, glassy shimmering crystal tones, occasional distant water drips, long reverb, eerie but beautiful, no percussion, seamless loop
Short cinematic scientific discovery sting: soft rising orchestral swell with shimmering bell chime resolving to a warm chord, awe and wonder
